escena: SCENE (a museum-grade vitrine in a dark empty gallery, seen straight on at case height): a single display case of clear low-iron tempered glass sits on a low plinth of MATTE BLACK powder-coated steel — dark, non-reflective, absorbing the light rather than bouncing it — five frameless panes, hairline silicone joints, contemporary and precise, no wood, no brass, no velvet. A thin LED strip recessed along the inside base of the case glows clean blue-white, the ONLY real light source in the frame, fully SHIELDED and throwing its light UPWARD into the case only — it does not spill onto the gallery floor, and the floor all around the plinth falls to unlit black, lighting the case from within so the glass reads unmistakably TRANSPARENT: the far wall of the gallery is visible straight through it, and the near pane throws a sharp hard-edged reflection. Inside the case, standing on the lit base, the small Clawd figure from the reference faces front, fully visible, nothing covering or cropping it, no pedestal under it and no cloth around it — the whole object open to view from every side. The gallery around it falls to black: no visitors, no other cases, no labels, no wall text, no paper, no printed matter of any kind, no plants. COLOUR: the environment is cool and contemporary — deep ink-blue blacks, the LED a clean blue-white, the plinth and the floor near black and matte, throwing NO bright specular reflection anywhere below the case; the figure's own warm colour is the ONLY warm thing in the frame and it does not spread. The gallery light, the glass and the metal stay strictly cool: no tungsten, no amber cast, no golden spill, no retro glow anywhere in the room. The case sits LOW in the frame — the top edge of the glass stays below 45% of the image height, with the dark plinth and an unlit matte floor filling the bottom, both reading near black; its light, its spill and every reflection it throws stay BELOW the middle of the image, while the upper third is an unbroken field of ink-blue darkness. Fine dust hangs in the light. 50mm lens at f/2.8, camera at case height. COMPOSITION FOR A WIDE HORIZONTAL FRAME: everything described above is pushed into the RIGHT HALF of the image; the LEFT 42% of the frame is empty unlit darkness — an unbroken vertical field of ink-blue black with no object, no creature, no light patch and no reflection in it, reserved for text.

texto.muro: the empty unlit left portion of the wide dark room, unbroken

lecho.objeto: the top rail of a low museum barrier in the immediate foreground, so close to the lens it dissolves into a soft abstract blur, running unbroken across the whole width of the frame and well outside the shielded case light
lecho.tono: dark matte powder-coated steel rail in complete shadow, receiving no light from the case at all, near black with only a faint matte grain
